Djinni Dataset (English Job Descriptions part)
	


	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

The Djinni Recruitment Dataset (English Job Descriptions part)  contains 150,000 job descriptions and 230,000 anonymized candidate CVs, posted between 2020-2023 on the Djinni IT job platform. The dataset includes samples in English and Ukrainian. 
The dataset contains various attributes related to job descriptions, including position titles, job descriptions, company names, experience requirements, keywords… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lang-uk/recruitment-dataset-job-descriptions-english.
